name: Deluin
about: Deluin is Zei's friend and fellow Minpentai finalist from Redshire in the United Cities. The book calls him an older teenager and later a young man in a sweater, and the rest of this look is invented, so contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: An older teenage boy sat down beside Zei.
facts.fact: An older teenage boy when introduced.

facts.quote: That's not a very Dzegojan name
Deluin replied in a lecturing tone
I have to fly back for my mom and dad's birthdays
a young man wearing only a sweater and a light hood climbing up
facts.fact: Later seen as a young man in only a sweater and a light hood in the snow.

descriptor: a young man of about eighteen, tall and long-limbed, pale skin, wavy shoulder-length light-brown hair, grey-green eyes and a calm, slightly serious face, wearing a thick cream cable-knit sweater cut as a long asymmetric tunic with a high folded collar and a light grey hood, dark green slim segmented trousers, a narrow dark sash and sturdy brown seamless boots

costume_notes: Keeps the sweater and light hood he wears in the snow, recut as a long asymmetric high-collared knit tunic in cooler Redshire tones.
